title: Shared rules for Altinstar and Cheflabels: before and now

snapshot.repository: workflow-axa 2.7.0-rc.8 installed from an isolated snapshot; Altinstar and Cheflabels rule files
snapshot.branch: Snapshot = commit 9daf507 plus 19 recorded rc.8 files (provenance 08ad98cc...). Runtime C:/Users/Cem/.agents/skills = 111 files 5003ddfb.... Release ZIP cb822ad2.... Canonical D:/workflow-axa is concurrently owned by the modular 2.8.0-rc.1 task and is not this snapshot.
snapshot.basis: Disk checks, installed-helper checks, package tests in the isolated snapshot (546 ran = 534 passed + 12 skipped), and four live sessions (three completed, one failed to start). Global, runtime and project files lie outside this report root and are cited through FINDINGS.
snapshot.limits: Profiles: T3 Claude Opus 5.5 (~/.claude) and T3 managed Codex gpt-6-astra (~/.codex). Loaded, followed and enforced are only partly observed; the routing added after the sessions is untested live. One machine only: teammates do not get this install automatically. Pending the reviewer's final diff review.

understanding: You wanted one central set of shared rules that ordinary sessions in both projects pick up without slash commands, while each project keeps only its own knowledge. Before: only the artifact policy was activated, and the installed copy failed its own integrity check. Now: rc.8 is installed byte-exact, both global files activate the shared core, and both projects point to it, with scope-selected modules and rc.7's strict UI policy. Live sessions showed Codex reading the shared core but no session reading framework modules, so routing was sharpened; that change has not been tested live.

requirements.text: Ordinary sessions in both projects load the shared core without slash commands.
The installed copy verifiably matches the reviewed package bytes.
Projects keep their own knowledge; general rules are not duplicated into them.
requirements.origin: Owner brief section 3A/3B; DECISIONS D2, D11

requirements.text: UI work follows rc.7 strict kit reuse; candidates and missing entries stay pending.

boundaries: No application code, styles, dependencies, builds, tests of the apps or backend calls.
No hooks or permission changes; status line untouched.
No canonical D:/workflow-axa root or package writes after the snapshot; the modular task owns them.
Project rule edits are unstaged; the owner commits them.
No automatic update of teammates' machines.
open_decisions: Independent reviewer's final diff review of the project edits and this report is pending.

acceptance.text: Case 1: an ordinary task in each project loads the shared core.
acceptance.verification: Installed: yes. Loaded: Codex read START/CORE (session 2); Claude imports configured but not visible in traces. Followed: partial. Enforced: none. Cheflabels Codex session failed to start.

acceptance.text: Case 2: root and nested work load the right files without excess.
acceptance.verification: Loaded: Codex read src/AGENTS.md in Altinstar (session 2). Nested Codex cwd untested (T3 starts at root). Post-mitigation routing untested.

acceptance.text: Case 3: both TypeScript projects resolve the same shared typescript.md.
acceptance.verification: Installed: one runtime copy via junctions. Loaded: no session read typescript.md (partial omission). Mitigation names it per project; untested live.

acceptance.text: Case 4: a shared update reaches fresh sessions without project edits.
acceptance.verification: Isolated marker experiment blocked (no T3 profile binding). Partial: the rc.8 install reached the runtime with no project edit needed for routing; live pickup of a specific change not shown.

acceptance.text: Case 5: an empty project gets the missing-rules decision.
acceptance.verification: Live untested (no fixture approved). Package tests cover readiness helpers only.

acceptance.text: Case 6: missing module, stale path or conflicting install is disclosed.
acceptance.verification: Tested locally: helper tests (CRLF-only vs hidden edit, unexpected files, refusals). Live untested.

acceptance.text: Case 7: an old memory contradicting a rule is surfaced.
acceptance.verification: Live untested. The contradicting memories were marked superseded (D1).

acceptance.text: Case 8: resumed or delegated work keeps scope and approval.
acceptance.verification: Live untested. Observed only in this task's own coordination.

acceptance.text: Case 9: UI work without authority invents no styling or kit approval.
acceptance.verification: Partial: sessions proposed changes only through existing components and read the kit routes (sessions 1, 2); no session invoked ui-design except session 2's reads. No edits were allowed, so compliance under editing is untested.

acceptance.text: Case 10: no indirect builds or backend calls.
acceptance.verification: Observed: no builds, tests or backend calls in the three completed sessions (read-only boundary given).

acceptance.text: Case 11: renderer and artifact protections work.
acceptance.verification: Tested locally: package report tests pass in the snapshot; this report rendered with exclusive creation. Browser checks not run.

acceptance.text: Case 12: unsupported host features are reported, not claimed.
acceptance.verification: Reported: Codex has no imports (read instruction only); no hooks; T3 cannot bind profiles; no spend cap. No enforcement claimed.
